description: Rothco’s MultiCam MOLLE Compatible Shovel Cover is the perfect accessory for outdoor enthusiasts, survivalists, and professionals who need to keep their essential gear secure and protected. Designed specifically to fit Rothco's Tri-Fold Shovel, this MOLLE cover is crafted from 1000D Cordura nylon Multicam fabric, known for its durability and resistance to wear in various environments. Whether you're on a rugged outdoor adventure or need reliable equipment storage, Rothco’s MultiCam MOLLE Shovel Cover delivers the protection and convenience you require.
